workshop.title: Make your own game
workshop.subtitle: Build a scene from ready-made shapes, write the rules with blocks, test it and publish in one click. No code, no file uploads.
workshop.publishedMeta: Live · {plays, plural, one {# play} other {# plays}} · {likes, plural, one {# like} other {# likes}}

platform-kosusu.title: Platform Run
platform-kosusu.description: Jump, grab the coins, dodge the patrols, reach the flag.

yorunge-savunmasi.title: Orbit Defence
yorunge-savunmasi.description: Steer the ship and shoot falling rocks. The waves keep speeding up.

labirent-kacisi.title: Maze Escape
labirent-kacisi.description: Find three keys, avoid the ghost, get out through the door.

top-toplama-3d.title: Gem Roller 3D
top-toplama-3d.description: Roll the ball, climb the ramp, collect the gems before time runs out.

engelli-kosu-3d.title: Obstacle Dash 3D
engelli-kosu-3d.description: Slide between lanes and jump the blocks. The track speeds up every five seconds.

kule-yig-3d.title: Tower Stack 3D
kule-yig-3d.description: Drop the sliding block at the right moment and build as high as you can.

bos-2d.title: Empty 2D scene
bos-2d.description: Just a floor. You build the rest.

bos-3d.title: Empty 3D scene
bos-3d.description: A flat floor and a camera. The rest is yours.

shapes.title: Build the scene
shapes.body: Boxes, spheres, ramps, stars... Drag, resize and colour shapes. Give an object a behavior to make it the player, a pickup or a trap.

blocks.title: Write the rules in blocks
blocks.body: Events, conditions, loops, variables, lists and functions. Blocks snap together and cannot be connected the wrong way.

publish.title: Test and publish
publish.body: Try it right away with the Play button. Once published anyone can play, and scores are verified on the server before they rank.

workshop.safety: Games made in the Workshop contain no code and no files; they are stored as a recipe that only the PLAYNEX engine reads, so they cannot harm anyone's device. Names and text go through a filter before publishing.

errors.generic: Could not create the project, try again.

errors.rate_limited: You are creating projects quickly, wait a little.
errors.invalid_input: Pick a template and give the game a name.

editor.title: Game name

status.conflict: This project changed in another tab

editor.noObjects: Click one of the shapes on the left.
editor.noPrefabs: Turn an object into a spawn template to copy it with blocks.
editor.viewport: Scene. Select an object and drag it; resize from the corners, rotate with the top handle.
editor.hint2d: Drag: move · Corners: size · Top handle: rotate · Alt: free
editor.hint3d: Drag: orbit the camera · Wheel: zoom · Click: select
editor.nothingSelected: Select an object in the scene to set its position, colour, physics and behaviors here.
editor.blocksHint: Blocks that are not under an event block do not run. Click a problem to jump to its block.

diagnostics.budgetExceeded: A loop ran too long and was stopped. Add a wait block inside it or repeat fewer times.
diagnostics.recursionTooDeep: A function called itself too deeply and was stopped.
diagnostics.stackOverflow: A calculation was nested too deeply and was stopped.
diagnostics.tooManyEntities: At most 2000 objects can exist at once; new copies were not created.
diagnostics.listFull: A list reached 10,000 items; the new item was not added.

bodies.staticHint: Never moves; for floors, walls and platforms.
bodies.dynamicHint: Falls with gravity, collides and stands on things; for players and balls.
bodies.kinematicHint: Moves at the speed you set, ignoring gravity and collisions; for patrols and bullets.

inspector.name: Name
inspector.prefabHint: Templates are not in the scene; the "spawn copy" block creates them wherever you want.
inspector.behaviorsHint: Ready-made behaviors work without blocks. Player behaviors add the player tag to the object.

settings.zeroMeansNone: 0 for time or lives means no limit.
settings.variablesHint: Numbers and text any block can read and change. Show them on screen in the HUD section.
settings.name: Name
settings.soundsHint: Sounds are synthesised by the PLAYNEX audio kit and played by name with the "play sound" block.
settings.label: Label

testPlay.title: Test run

publish.title: Publish your game
publish.description: The published version is frozen; you can keep editing and publish again later.
publish.summaryHint: Up to 300 characters. Shown on the community page.
publish.rules: Names, text and the description go through a profanity filter. Games that break the rules are taken down.
publish.doneDescription: Share the link; scores from signed-in players go on the leaderboard.

errors.save_failed: The latest changes could not be saved; fix that first and try again.
errors.invalid_document: A few things need fixing first:
errors.offensive_text: The name, description or some text in the game is not allowed.

desktopOnly.title: The editor needs a wide screen
desktopOnly.description: Use a computer or a tablet in landscape to build games. On your phone you can play the games in Community.

errors.tooLarge: The game is too large (512 KB at most).
errors.malformed: The game file could not be read.
errors.unsupportedVersion: This game was made with a newer version of the editor.
errors.tooMany: A limit was exceeded (objects, blocks, variables or lists).
errors.duplicateId: Two objects share the same id.
errors.duplicateName: The same name is used twice.
errors.invalidName: A name is empty, too long or starts with #.
errors.textTooLong: Text can be at most 120 characters.
errors.outOfRange: A value is outside its allowed range.
errors.invalidPolygon: A polygon needs between 3 and 32 corners.
errors.unknownVariable: No variable with that name. Add it in game settings or fix the name.
errors.unknownPrefab: No spawn template with that name.
errors.unknownSound: No sound with that name. Add it in game settings.
errors.wrongArgumentCount: The function got the wrong number of inputs.
errors.nestingTooDeep: Blocks are nested too deeply (32 levels at most).
errors.shapeNotInDimension: This shape cannot be used in this dimension.
errors.behaviorNeedsMovingBody: This behavior needs a Physical or Moving body.
errors.eventNotForStage: This event only works on objects.
